title: Wear OS smartwatch as collector combined with libre Wifi (libre bluettoth + wifi) resulting with problem of doubled historical data
body:
In the environment of Libre sensor with MM and Wear OS smartwatch that is forced collector while combined with multiple RaspberryPIs with LibreAllHouse for full house coverage, the RPis are dominantly collecting data from MM and in some occasions (person with MM moving around the house) when the watch itself collects the data (it also collects all historical data, last 12 h) the master phone accepts all those, already processed,  historical data now again from smartwatch which results with double historical data. From the words of one of the experts, @tzachi-dar , the master phone does not filter that data when it comes from the watch. This, per se, is not such a big problem, but it can result with some confusing issues I have also encountered:

1. When there is calibration in those last 12 hours it can result with two different historical curves. If calibration was significantly different from previous data then double historical data can be pretty different – picture with same doubled data in xDrip and NS resulting from calibration around 6:45AM. The upper curve is the initial one and the lower curve resulted from that calibration when the watch created double historical data:
![xdriphistoryandns](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24623289/50573316-0f26b900-0dd2-11e9-8bd7-dc27b2a8992e.jpg)

2. When the situation of double historical data happens the main screen of xDrip+ on master phone does not any more display data for full last 24h. Instead it only displays data for approx. last 12 hours. It seems that there is a limit of number of data displayed in xDrip? The data is not lost from xDrip but it is not displayed on the main screen:
![xdripmainscreen](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24623289/50573319-1cdc3e80-0dd2-11e9-94c7-bcb39e3cbf96.jpg)
